subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below.
stimulus: We has become a common expression to all in our country There means hardly any man who is not familiar with this term Tree plantation cannot the best time for tree plantation June and July is planting more and more trees are think of our existence without trees
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table: (i) Tree plantation has become a common expression to all in our country. (ii) There is hardly any man who is not familiar with this term. (iii) Tree plantation means planting more and more trees. (iv) June and July are the best time for tree plantation. (v) We cannot think of our existence without trees.
